snippet.title: THE SPIRIT LIFT Launch Trailer! Available NOW!
snippet.description:
Pick your team, collect cards, battle creatures, and resurrect the hotel in 👻🏨 THE SPIRIT LIFT by prettysmart games. Dare to take a ride on this survival horror roguelike deckbuilder?

Available now on Steam (and soon on Itch.io) ▶️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727590/THE_SPIRIT_LIFT/

Thank you for being here for our journey! We're so glad to finally share the game with you!

#indie #horror #gametrailers
